subject: Surgical expunction request for single conversation - ORION-927
messages:
From: Samira Rahman <samira.rahman@orion-therapeutics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: remove single conversation from audit logs (ORION-927)

Hi Jordan,

We have a sensitive conversation in our logs that needs to be removed from Redwood's activity/audit exports. Per our internal legal review this is limited to one thread (details below). Can you advise what information you need from Orion Therapeutics to process a targeted removal and confirmation that the removal will not affect other records?

Thread identifier: ORION-927
Approximate subject line: "Clinical API onboarding - credential exchange"
Approximate date range: 2027-03-28 to 2027-03-29

I've attached a signed authorization form from our GC and a small header export containing the message-ids. Please escalate to the security/compliance team and let me know the next steps. We need a clear audit trail and confirmation once the thread is purged from searchable activity logs and telemetry exports.

Thanks,
Samira Rahman
Head of Integrations
Orion Therapeutics
attachment: authorization_form_signed.pdf
attachment: thread_export_headers.txt

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samira Rahman <samira.rahman@orion-therapeutics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: remove single conversation from audit logs (ORION-927)

Samira,

Thanks for the details and the signed form — that's a good start. For internal audit and to keep a clear chain of custody we need the following items before we can action a surgical expunction:

- Confirm the exact message-ids (or full RFC-822 headers) for the messages to remove.
- Confirm the specific Redwood exports you want excluded (activity/audit CSVs, internal telemetry, or both).
- Confirm whether you require deletion from long-term backups (if applicable) or only from operational exports and the console.

I'll loop in Neha from Security to confirm our process and any SLA implications. Once we have the final header list, we'll schedule the removal job and provide a signed attestation showing the records removed and export snapshots before/after.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T08:25:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Request: remove single conversation from audit logs (ORION-927)

Jordan / Monica,

Per Samira's request: I reviewed the signed authorization and the initial header list. Before we run an expunction we need the explicit RFC-822 headers for each message to avoid over-broad deletion — Samira referenced an approximate date range but that isn't safe for a surgical removal.

Operational notes for the job:
- We'll run a targeted query by message-id and sha256(header) to identify all artifacts in: activity exports, telemetry event store (30-day retention for EU), and the per-customer audit index.
- For backups: we do not perform retroactive deletions from immutable backups unless there's a lawful order. We can however mark those records internally as "excluded from reporting" and prevent them from being surfaced in future exports.
- We'll produce a signed attestation and CSV list of removed message-ids.

If Orion confirms the full header list and clarifies they accept the backup handling described above, we can schedule the work for a maintenance window (ETA 48-72 business hours after confirmation).

Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Samira Rahman <samira.rahman@orion-therapeutics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T15:44:00Z

Hi Neha / Jordan,

Thanks — attaching the exported headers with full RFC-822 lines (thread_export_headers.txt). That file contains the three message-ids we want removed. To confirm: we accept Redwood's approach to backups (mark as excluded from reporting, not removed from immutable backups) provided you include that acknowledgement in the attestation.

Please proceed with the targeted removal and schedule within the 48-72 business hour window. We prefer a late-afternoon maintenance window in CET to minimize impact.

Samira
